failures.triage_note: Reproducible 100% of the time on /listings/. The Enter-key path and the explicit Search-button click path diverge even though the URL update and REST fetch are byte-identical between them (both hit GET /wp-json/listora/v1/search?keyword=<term>&sort=featured&page=1&per_page=20&facets=true and both get a correctly-filtered 200 response) - the fetch success handler that updates the rendered grid appears wired only to the button's data-wp-on--click action, not to whatever keydown/submit path Enter takes. This is the IAPI directive class of bug documented in this plugin's own CLAUDE.md (a state update not reaching the element that renders it). Root cause not isolated (verification pass only) - check src/interactivity/store.js search actions and the listing-search/listing-grid view.js Enter-key binding vs the Search button's click binding.
failures.expected: Pressing Enter in the directory search combobox re-fetches and re-renders the listing grid with keyword-filtered results, identical to what clicking the visible 'Search' button does.
failures.actual: Pressing Enter updates the URL to ?keyword=<term> and fires the correct, correctly-filtered REST request (verified via Network tab: 200, matching results), but the visible grid never re-renders - it keeps showing the original 20-27 unfiltered cards, several of which share no relation to the typed keyword (e.g. keyword 'Bethesda' still showed 'Dr. Maya Patel, MD - Family Medicine', 'Sunny 2BR Loft in SoHo', etc.). The '.listora-grid__empty' 'No listings found' empty-state card also renders simultaneously underneath the stale populated grid - two contradictory states shown at once, violating cross-cutting checks 8/9. Clicking the explicit 'Search' button on the same page, with the same typed keyword, correctly narrows the grid to only the matching card(s).
